碧浪群岛（碧浪群岛（第22页）这日，六月十五。一只金灿灿的灵舟从碧浪群岛西方驶来，悬停在一座方圆千里的卫岛上空。船头上站着四人，一位暗金色长袍中年男子，一名圆脸大肚侏儒，一名莲冠青年，以及一名身材修长的暗金纹玄袍青年。正是从苍炎岛赶回来的叶见春一行。此时，叶见春正手指视线尽头那座若隐若现的核心岛屿，给韩林和颜童子介绍着碧浪群岛的情况，以及叶家一些基本规矩。韩林和颜童子认真听着，不时露出一抹震撼之色，这让那位叶青锋颇为得意。这时，叶见春又看向灵舟下方的岛屿：“此岛名为飞流岛，面积大概方圆一千五百里，目前还是空着的，你们可以任选一地作为自己的洞府，方圆百里便是你们的私人领地！”“叶家每隔一段时间，会有人过来给你们送最新的任务清单，你们可以做，也可以不做。”“不过我建议你们，如果有时间的话，最好做一点任务。因为这不仅能挣取贡献积分换资源，将来如果你们想成为正式客卿，对累积贡献也是有要求的。”“明白。”韩林见颜童子不说话，为免冷场，就笑着接了一句。“好，大概就是这样，你们自己忙去吧！基础物资奖励，我会尽快给你们送过来，切记一点，没有允许，不得进入和窥探核心岛屿，否则后果很严重。”“是。”两人闻言同时抱了下拳，随后一转身，就飞出了灵舟。灵舟继续启程，向着碧浪群岛的核心之地飞去。颜童子和韩林站在半空，目送灵舟离开后，开始认真打量起脚下这座岛屿。最终发现，此岛的南方、东北和西北，都各有一座鹤立鸡群般的高大雄峰。而且三座山峰都有灵脉存在，灵气很足。值得一说的是，灵脉和灵石矿是两回事。有灵脉的地方，只能说天地灵气比较集中，浓郁度高，被修行者吸收后恢复也快。但这并不代表，它就有灵石矿存在。灵石矿是需要灵脉日积月累，再结合某些特殊的土质，才能诞生出来的。不过两者之间也存在一定联系。简单地说，灵石矿需要灵脉为基础，而灵脉是天地自然孕育而成的。韩林和颜童子在飞流岛上游走了一圈，就近感受了一下三座雄峰的灵气。最终发现，最南边这座雄峰的灵气是最浓郁的，而且灵气品质也不错，简单吸一口空气，就让人感到神清气爽。“主上，此峰不错，要不你就住这儿吧？东北那一座稍微差点，我到那边去住。”颜童子主动放弃此峰争夺权，因为他知道，就算争，也争不到。不料韩林听后却摇了摇头，“不用，还是你住这里吧，我到东北那座去住。”“啊？这，怎么好意思呢。”颜童子有点难以置信，韩林竟会放弃灵气最浓郁的一座洞府之地。“不用跟我客气，此峰格局不是我喜欢的，我还是更喜欢东北方向那座，上面有大片竹林，感觉舒服些。”韩林笑着说罢，直接身形一晃，就向飞流岛的东北方向破空而去。

> Chapter 483 Bilang Islands (Page 1)
Bilang Islands (Bilang Islands (page 22)) Today is June 15th. A golden spirit boat sails from the west of Bilang Islands and hovers over an island with a radius of thousands of miles. There are four people standing on the bow, a middle-aged man in dark golden robes, a round-faced pot-bellied dwarf, a young man with a lotus crown, and a slender young man in dark gold-patterned black robes. It is Ye Jianchun and his party who have rushed back from Cangyan Island. At this time, Ye Jianchun is making a move. Pointing to the looming core island at the end of the line of sight, he introduced Han Lin and Yan Tongzi about the Bilang Islands and some basic rules of the Ye family. Han Lin and Yan Tongzi listened carefully, showing a look of shock from time to time, which made Ye Qingfeng quite proud. At this time, Ye Jianchun looked at the island below the Lingzhou: "This island is called Feiliu Island, with an area of about 1,500 miles. It is still vacant. You can choose any place. As your own cave, the radius of a hundred miles is your private territory!" "Every once in a while, someone from the Ye family will come and give you the latest task list. You can do it or not." "But I suggest that if you have time, you'd better do some tasks, because not only can you earn contribution points in exchange for resources, but if you want to become an official guest in the future, there are also requirements for accumulated contributions." Bai." Seeing that Yan Tongzi didn't speak, Han Lin added with a smile. "Okay, that's it. You can go on your own! I will send you the basic material rewards as soon as possible. Remember, you are not allowed to enter and spy on the core island without permission, otherwise the consequences will be serious." After hearing this, the two fisted at the same time, then turned around and flew out of the spirit boat. The spirit boat continued to set off towards the Bilang Islands. Yan Tongzi and Han Lin stood in mid-air, watching the spirit boat leave, and then began to carefully look at the island at their feet. Finally, they found that there were tall and majestic peaks in the south, northeast and northwest of the island, and there were spiritual veins on the three peaks. It is worth mentioning that the spiritual veins and the spiritual stone mines are two different things. Where there are spiritual veins, it can only be said that the spiritual energy of heaven and earth is relatively concentrated. , it recovers quickly after being absorbed by practitioners. But this does not mean that it has a spiritual stone mine. The spiritual stone mine requires the accumulation of spiritual veins over time and combined with certain special soil qualities. However, there is a certain connection between the two. The spiritual veins are naturally nurtured by heaven and earth. Han Lin and Yan Tongzi walked around Feiliu Island and felt the strength of the three peaks. Spiritual energy. Finally, it was discovered that the spiritual energy of the southernmost peak is the richest, and the quality of the spiritual energy is also good. A simple breath of air makes people feel refreshed. "My lord, this peak is good, why don't you live here? The one in the northeast is a little bit worse, I will live there." Yan Tongzi voluntarily gave up the fight for the right to this peak, because he knew that even if he fought, he would not win. Unexpectedly, Han Lin shook his head after hearing this. You stay here, I'll go to the one in the northeast." "Huh? How can you be so embarrassed?" Yan Tongzi couldn't believe that Han Lin would give up a cave with the strongest aura. "Don't be polite to me. I don't like the layout of this peak. I still prefer the one in the northeast. It has a large bamboo forest on it. It feels more comfortable." Han Lin said with a smile, and walked towards the northeast of Feiliu Island.
